(k) Taxes. The contract price includes all applicable Federal, State, and local taxes and duties. (l) Termination for the Government's convenience. The Government reserves the right to terminate this contract, or any part hereof, for its sole convenience. In the event of such termination, the Contractor shall immediately stop all work and shall immediately cause any and all of its suppliers and subcontractors to cease work. Subject to the terms of this contract, the Contractor shall be paid a percentage of the contract price reflecting the percentage of the work performed prior to the notice of termination, plus reasonable charges the Contractor can demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Government using its standard record keeping system, have resulted from the termination. The Contractor shall not be required to comply with the cost accounting standards or contract cost principles for this purpose. sla_onsite.text: Settings> ===== FILE: files/P09_SOW_VALL_Radiometer_ABL90_Flex_Plus_AQURE_Platinum_Software_OR_EQUAL.pdf ===== STATEMENT OF WORK VA Loma Linda – Radiometer AQURE Service Platinum Software OR EQUAL 1. INTRODUCTION / BACKGROUND INFORMATION The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Loma Linda Medical Center (VALLMC) requires a comprehensive service contract for its Radiometer AQURE software platform (including associated FlexLink functionality) OR EQUAL. AQURE is the centralized middleware and data management system that connects Radiometer blood gas analyzers to the laboratory information system and electronic health record. Continuous availability, security, and interoperability of this software are essential to support real-time patient testing, result delivery, and clinical decision-making for Veterans. This Statement of Work (SOW) deﬁnes the technical and performance requirements for a contractor to provide software updates, operating system maintenance, remote and onsite support, ADT/HL7 interface troubleshooting, documentation, and related services for the Radiometer AQURE software environment installed at VALLMC. 2.
